title: Console orientation pack: empty-state illustrations, tip cards, and first-session checklist
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design collateral and screenshot-ready assets for the Console's first-session orientation. This ticket covers three deliverable groups: (1) a set of lightweight empty-state illustrations tailored to common console screens, (2) contextual tip cards and microcopy for the first two sessions, and (3) a compact first-session checklist UI that surfaces next actions and telemetry opt-ins. The goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new developer users while keeping the visuals brand-aligned and lightweight for fast loading in the Console.
acceptance_criteria: Empty-state illustrations exported in SVG and 2x PNG for 6 Console screens (Projects, Models, Deployments, Billing, Settings, Integrations)
Tip cards content approved by PM and Engineering and stored as JSON snippets for developer consumption
Checklist UI component spec with states (empty, partial, completed) and responsive breakpoints in the component library PR
Design tokens and colors validated against dark/light themes and accessibility contrast targets
All assets uploaded to release Drive folder and Figma file linked; handoff notes created for Eng with image optimization guidelines
decisions: Use flat two-tone illustration style (brand teal + neutral gray) to keep payload small and consistent with Console language
Tip cards will be delivered as content JSON so Engineering can choose render ordering and A/B experimentation
Checklist should default to 'collapsed' on small viewports and expand on first interaction to avoid layout shifts
No animated Lottie files for initial release to prioritize page load; micro-interactions handled via CSS transitions

Provide two color tokens for illustrations: --illustration-accent and --illustration-neutral
